title: Trade on Binance Spot and Convert Using Simple Earn Flexible Assets!
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce a new feature that allows users to trade on  Spot  and  Convert  using their  Earn Account balance  from assets subscribed to  Simple Earn Flexible Products.  This provides users a more convenient and efficient way to earn APR rewards on their idle crypto assets without interrupting their trading activities.  Once users place a Spot order with Simple Earn Flexible assets, the corresponding assets will be  automatically redeemed  from their Simple Earn Flexible Products positions to their Spot Accounts for trading.  Currently, this feature is available on the Binance App only, stay tuned for the website version in the near future. Start Trading Now! How to Trade with Simple Earn Flexible Assets Spot Navigate to [Trade] and Choose [Spot]. Tap [Avbl]. Check the box next to [Earn - Flexible Assets] and tap [Confirm]. Your Spot order will be placed using your Simple Earn Flexible assets. Convert Navigate to [Trade] and Choose [Convert]. Tap [Available]. Check the box next to [Earn - Flexible Assets] and [Confirm]. Your Convert order will be placed using your Simple Earn Flexible assets. Notes: Users must update their Binance App to the latest version (i.e., v2.96.1 or above) to use this new feature. When users place a Spot order with BNB Simple Earn Flexible Products, the corresponding BNB will be redeemed from their Simple Earn Flexible Products positions, and thus they are  not eligible for Launchpool and HODLer Airdrops rewards . When making a trade, funds will be drawn down in the following order:  Spot Account Funding Account Earn - Flexible Assets More Information: Introduction to Binance Simple Earn How to Use Binance Convert Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Convert Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-03-06 Note:  This announcement was updated on 2025-03-06 to clarify the process of Earn asset redemption for Spot orders.
